rows.text: Such calculations shall either be performed by one person and independently verified by a second person, or, if the yield is calculated by automated equipment under § 211.68, be independently verified by one person.

1. Purpose

To set out the checks made on in-process material during granulation, blending, compression and coating, and how the yield of each step is worked out.

4.1 In-process limits are those written in the master record. 4.2 Each result is compared with its limit; a result outside the limit stops the step until QA decides. 4.3 Blend samples are tested by QC for assay and uniformity, and QA releases the blend before compression starts. 4.4 Rejected granules or tablets are labelled REJECTED and moved to the locked reject cage.

rows.section_title: 211.110 Sampling and testing of in-process materials and drug products.
rows.context: 211.110 Sampling and testing of in-process materials and drug products.
rows.text: To assure batch uniformity and integrity of drug products, written procedures shall be established and followed that describe the in-process controls, and tests, or examinations to be conducted on appropriate samples of in-process materials of each batch.

passages.text:
1. Purpose

To set out the checks made on in-process material during granulation, blending, compression and coating, and how the yield of each step is worked out.

3. In-process checks

3.1 The master record of each product lists the in-process checks, the samples taken for them and the limits; operators follow it for every batch. 3.2 These checks monitor the output of each step and show whether granulation, blending and compression perform as validated. 3.3 At the press, the weight of 20 tablets is checked every 30 minutes against the weight limits, with hardness, thickness and friability. 3.4 Blend uniformity is shown by ten samples from the blender tested for content uniformity. 3.5 Dissolution of the coated tablets is tested at the end of coating. 3.

4. Limits and results

4.1 In-process limits are those written in the master record. 4.2 Each result is compared with its limit; a result outside the limit stops the step until QA decides. 4.3 Blend samples are tested by QC for assay and uniformity, and QA releases the blend before compression starts. 4.4 Rejected granules or tablets are labelled REJECTED and moved to the locked reject cage.
